1098-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
1098-accept.text:
In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence.  $N has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!

So here is your task, $N.  Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent.  Find them, and if they require aid then give it.

This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, $N.  Do not fail.
1098-accept.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

444-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
444-progress.text: My studies require great concentration.  So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
444-progress.title: Rot Hide Origins

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?

78127-complete.name: Owen Thadd
78127-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78127-complete.title: The Dalaran Digest

78127-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78127-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78127-progress.title: The Dalaran Digest

95216-accept.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-accept.text:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. $N appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even $r flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216-accept.title: The New Plague

98299-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98299-accept.text:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine. Be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. $N appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken such as ourselves, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal.
98299-accept.title: Stop the Spread
